issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Milkable.messageOnMilk() should return a String (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked") and examples in the template Main print the returned value. However, the solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type boolean and the implementing classes (Goat and Seal) print the milking message and return a boolean. This return-type mismatch between specification/template and the solution will confuse students and cause incompatibility with expected usage (printing the milking message string).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Milkable interface in the solution to declare messageOnMilk() returning String, and modify Goat and Seal to return the milking message string (e.g., return "Goat " + getName() + " is milked"). Ensure implementations do not print internally unless also returning the string; this aligns the solution with the problem specification and the template Main usage.
